capability.summary: Convert one amount between two currencies via exchangerate.host
capability.description: Calls exchangerate.host's fixed convert endpoint with required from/to currency codes and an optional amount defaulting to 1. It performs provider-side amount conversion, distinct from Frankfurter's latest reference-rate lookup.
capability.problem_space: Numeric currency conversion for one amount and currency pair; not historical rates, central-bank reference-rate retrieval, or financial advice.

constraint.io_signature: Input: from currency at CLI position 1, to currency at position 2, and optional amount at position 3. Output: shared JSON envelope containing exchangerate.host conversion result, URL, and HTTP status. HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.
accepted_inputs: optional amount string; wrapper default is 1
constraint.output_shape: HTTP 2xx/3xx: {status: "success", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}. HTTP 4xx/5xx: {status: "error", tool: string, url: string, http_status: integer, result: object|string}, exit 1. Request exception: {status: "error", tool: string, message: string}, exit 1.
limitations: fixed GET https://api.exchangerate.host/convert with from=<arg1>, to=<arg2>, amount=<arg3 or 1>
no date, historical range, rate source, rounding, batch conversion, or pagination input; all CLI arguments after position 3 are ignored
wrapper does not locally calculate, validate, parse, paginate, or truncate the provider result
no auth, cache, retry, or caller-selected timeout
HTTP 2xx/3xx responses produce a success envelope; HTTP 4xx/5xx responses produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit; request exceptions also produce an error envelope and a non-zero exit.

output_contract.description: Shared JSON envelope containing exchangerate.host conversion result for the requested amount and currency pair, URL, and HTTP status.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

negative_intents: look up ECB reference rates without an amount
